The captain answered honestly: not ten yet by the measure that counts — finished work in front of his eyes; several pages went back tonight (the agreement story unfold, the Personal covers). Shawn: "So from all that you can improve for the next time." He asked for ten things to improve performance and experience; the captain committed — prove every tap opens before filing; agreement unfold plus covers open plus buttons land right; orbs stay with gauges; clear old pages; eye checks in real time; learn from each return; fix root not surface; show finished work only; hold the ten-star standard. Nine commitments as recorded against an ask for ten — the tenth is owed. Shawn reacted 👍; to the ultra-productive-tonight plan he reacted 🙏.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the teacher asks, "Can you be the very best?" and the student says honestly, "Not yet — but here's how I'll get there!" And she writes down ten ways to be better — and she means every single one! That's how you grow, sweetheart: you tell the truth, and then you do better, and better, and better!
